# Paths exempt from scripts/check-added-blobs.sh.

# One repo-relative path per line; `#` starts a comment. An entry here says a
# reviewer agreed that this specific large or binary file belongs in git rather
# than in git-lfs or a release artifact. Prefer git-lfs for media; prefer not
# committing build output at all.
#
# The NCC 2026 talk page (D-777) serves these from public/. They cannot be LFS:
# the deployment checkout does not pull LFS, so it would publish the pointer file
# (see the microsite exception in .gitattributes).

cassini-microsite/public/nextcloud-conf-2026/voice-is-context-slides.pdf

# and checks these assets via scripts/sync-embed.mjs --check.
